title: Decentralized Optimization with Mixed Affine Constraints
summary: This paper considers decentralized optimization of convex functions with mixed affine equality constraints involving both local and global variables. Constraints on global variables may vary across different nodes in the network, while local variables are subject to coupled and node-specific constraints. Such problem formulations arise in machine learning applications, including federated learning and multi-task learning, as well as in resource allocation and distributed control.
